short_name.description: The short local name for the Bluetooth controller (max 11 chars).

local_name.description: The full local name for the Bluetooth controller (max 249 chars).

class_of_device.description: Class of Device in Major:Minor format for BR/EDR controllers.

appearance.description: Appearance value (0x03C0) for LE advertising, e.g., Generic Phone.

powered.description: Enable/Disable the Bluetooth controller power state.

br_edr.description: Enable/Disable Basic Rate/Enhanced Data Rate support.

discoverable_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for discoverable mode.

fast_connectable.description: Enable fast connectable mode for BR/EDR.

bondable.description: Enable bondable mode, allowing automatic pairing requests.

static_address.description: Static Random Address for LE controllers (XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX).

uuids.description: List of UUIDs to publish in advertising data. Each item is a flat map: {uuid: string, svc_hint: bool}.

uuids.items.description: Schema for individual UUID items in the uuids list.

uuids.items.svc_hint.description: Whether to modify CoD service class bits for this UUID.

debug_keys.description: Debug keys policy: 0=Discard on disconnect, 1=Discard on reboot, 2=Debug mode.

scan_interval.description: LE Scan Interval in ms (for connection establishment).

devices.description: List of devices to add to the action list. Each item is a flat map: {address: string, address_type: number, action: number}.

devices.items.description: Schema for individual device items in the devices list.

blocked_devices.description: List of blocked device addresses. Each item is a flat map: {address: string, address_type: number}.

blocked_devices.items.description: Schema for individual blocked device items.

system_config.description: Default system configuration parameters. Key is Parameter_Type ID, Value is the integer value.

system_config.type.description: Placeholder type for system config items to satisfy schema constraints, though rendered as a map.
